title: SeCom: On Memory Construction and Retrieval for Personalized Conversational Agents

contributions.purpose: 回答长期对话个性化 agent 中『哪种记忆粒度(turn/session/summary)最有效』这一未解问题,揭示现有粒度的局限
contributions.mechanism: 在检索增强响应生成范式下系统性地对比 turn-level、session-level、summarization 三种记忆粒度的检索准确率与检索内容语义质量(分析手法:检索 DCG/recall 曲线 + 端到端 QA 对照)
contributions.evaluation: 发现三种粒度均有局限:turn-level 过细导致上下文碎片化、session-level 过粗含无关信息、summary 有信息损失;由 Figure 1/2 与 Table 1 的检索 DCG 与响应质量曲线支撑
contributions.domain: 对话系统 / 检索增强的个性化对话 agent
contributions.source_quote: We systematically investigate the effects of memory granularity on retrieval augmented response generation in conversational agents. Our findings reveal that turn-level, session-level, and summarization-based approaches each face challenges in ensuring precise retrieval and providing a complete, relevant, and coherent context.

contributions.purpose: 利用自然语言固有冗余作为检索噪声这一洞察,提出用提示压缩作为记忆去噪手段
contributions.mechanism: 论证自然语言冗余会成为检索系统噪声,提出在检索前用 prompt compression(LLMLingua-2)对记忆单元去噪;分析压缩率对 recall 与 query-segment 相似度的影响
contributions.evaluation: 压缩率>50% 时 LLMLingua-2 一致提升 BM25/MPNet 检索 recall;去噪后 query 与相关 segment 相似度上升、与无关 segment 相似度下降(Figure 3)
contributions.domain: 对话系统 / 检索增强
contributions.source_quote: We contend that the inherent redundancy in natural language can act as noise for retrieval systems. We demonstrate that prompt compression technique, LLMLingua-2, can serve as an effective denoising method to enhance memory retrieval performance.

contributions.purpose: 基于上述洞察构建段级记忆的完整系统 SeCom,并验证其在长期对话与对话分割任务上的优越性
contributions.mechanism: 提出 SeCom:引入对话分割(SEgmentation)模型将长对话切成主题连贯的 segment 构建段级记忆,并对记忆单元做基于压缩(COMpression)的去噪;分割模型可零样本或经 LLM reflection(仅 100 例)学习分割规则
contributions.evaluation: 在 LOCOMO 与 Long-MT-Bench+ 上显著超越 baselines(GPT4Score);分割模型在 DialSeg711/TIAGE/SuperDialSeg 无监督设置下超越 baseline,迁移学习设置下仅用 100 例反超全量训练的监督 baseline;消融:去掉压缩去噪 LOCOMO 掉最多 9.46 分
contributions.domain: 对话系统 / 对话分割
contributions.source_quote: We present SECOM, a system that constructs memory bank at segment level by introducing a conversation SEgmentation model, while applying COMpression based denoising on memory units to enhance memory retrieval. ... SECOM outperforms baselines on two long-term conversation benchmark LOCOMO and Long-MT-Bench+.

self_declared_provenance.quote: These approaches typically construct a memory bank from the conversation history at either the turn-level (Yuan et al., 2023) or session-level (Wang et al., 2023). Chen et al. (2024), Li et al. (2024) and Zhong et al. (2024) further leverage summarization techniques to build memory units.

During response generation, we directly concatenate the retrieved segment-level memory units as the context as in Yuan et al. (2023); Kim et al. (2024), bypassing summarization to avoid the information loss.
(8) MemoChat (Lu et al., 2023), which operates memories at segment level, but focuses on tuning LLMs for both memory construction and retrieval.
we propose removing such redundancy from memory units prior to retrieval by leveraging prompt compression methods such as LLMLingua-2 (Pan et al., 2024).

notes: 结果整体正面,主报告 SeCom 全面超越 baselines。一个值得注意的观察(非本方法负结果):turn/session-level baseline 对检索器高度敏感,换用 BM25 vs MPNet 在 LOCOMO/Long-MT-Bench+ 上波动达 11.98/7.89 GPT4Score,而 SeCom 更稳健。消融证实两组件均有贡献(去压缩去噪掉 9.46 分)。与最接近工作 MemoChat(同为段级记忆)的区分点:MemoChat 需微调 LLM,SeCom 用独立分割模型 + 压缩去噪。
